groundExtension.proposedTypedField: AbilityBehavior.groundArea?: {durationRounds:1|2|3|4, visualPresetId:registered GroundVisualPresetId, entryEffectIds:readonly distinct stable effect IDs[], timing?:instant|next-round|delayed}
groundExtension.parser: Ground-only target with selected footprint; reject unknown/duplicate/unresolvable effect IDs, actor-only entry payloads, unsupported entry types, invalid clocks and Controlled persistent Ground. Exactly one group-owned area per activation.
groundExtension.compiler: Resolve stable entry effect IDs to native effect ordinals only after final canonical compilation. Preserve effect order, conditional eligibility, origins, timing modes and legal recipient arrays while filtering/expanding specialized effects. Route through the existing Ground handler.
groundExtension.capture: Capture immutable group+version, sourceCombatant/team, exact legal footprint, caster stats/profile, content, entry effects/origins, source-command visibility, activationRound and expiresAtRound; never project private caster values.
groundExtension.clock: Use existing captured timing offsets0/1/2 and bounded1–4round duration; no arbitrary refresh extension. Recast creates a new sourced application under current captured Ground policy rather than changing history.
groundExtension.entry: Preserve existing once-per-source/recipient/turn entry claims and existing Airborne/recipient/traversal legality; entry-only effects never repeat actor-only Fire cleanse. Do not add damage on no-input absent an actual eligible native entry/clock event.
groundExtension.lifecycle: Source ownership remains captured. Follow existing Ground source-removal behavior without inventing refunds; queued/persistent captured areas survive restore consistently. Terminal cleanup removes pending entry authority and prevents late packets/rewards.
tests: Reject unit-target persistent field and unknown/duplicate effect IDs.
Compile each of the3exact retained areas; ordinal expansion/filtering preserves effect/origin/timing/recipient alignment.
Entry, leave/reenter, duplicate receipt and same-source recast retain the existing per-turn claim budget.
Capture/reload/source removal preserves exact caster/content/origins/visibility and legal finite lifetime.
Frozen Ground→Steam conversion retains original expiry; actor-only Fire Chilled cleanse occurs only at cast.
Airborne, Rooted, terrain/occupancy, source defeat and terminal/no-input boundaries preserve native outcomes.
Master editor/preview, public reader, PvE/PvP controllers and actual AI choose/quote/commit a legal persistent area.
